forehead_shine.title: Forehead shine
forehead_shine.body: Your forehead and nose look shiny — a sign of an oily T-zone.
forehead_shine.tip: A light, oil-free moisturizer and a BHA cleanser can help.

under_eye.title: Under-eyes
under_eye.body: The skin under your eyes looks darker than your cheeks.
under_eye.tip: Sleep, daily sunscreen and an eye cream with caffeine or vitamin C may help.

cheek_texture.title: Cheek texture
cheek_texture.body: Your cheeks show some bumps or uneven texture.
cheek_texture.tip: Gentle exfoliation (AHA/BHA) 2–3 times a week can smooth it.

cheek_redness.title: Cheek redness
cheek_redness.body: There are redder patches on your cheeks.
cheek_redness.tip: Calming ingredients like centella or niacinamide help; skip harsh scrubs.

nose_pores.title: Nose pores
nose_pores.body: The pores around your nose look more visible.
nose_pores.tip: Salicylic acid (BHA) or niacinamide helps keep pores clear.

hydration.what: How smooth and supple your skin's surface looks. Dry skin looks rougher and duller.
hydration.tip: Use a hydrating serum (hyaluronic acid) and a moisturizer every day.

elasticity.what: How few fine lines show on your forehead and under your eyes.
elasticity.tip: Daily sunscreen and a gentle retinoid at night help with fine lines.

pigmentation.what: How even your skin tone is — fewer dark spots and marks score higher.
pigmentation.tip: Daily SPF plus vitamin C or niacinamide helps even out tone.

texture.what: How smooth your cheeks look — fewer bumps and rough patches score higher.
texture.tip: Gentle exfoliation (AHA/BHA) 2–3 times a week smooths texture.

pores.what: How visible the pores on your nose are — less visible scores higher.
pores.tip: Salicylic acid (BHA) or niacinamide helps keep pores clear.

marketing.title: Marketing Strategy — status per channel
marketing.intro: The original wireframe shows an iROAS/CAC diagnosis per ad channel (TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, Influencer, etc.) and MMM budget allocation. This project only has one channel that's genuinely measurable: the promo code attached to an event (Phase 2). The rest needs ad-API integrations and per-transaction sales data that don't exist — flagged honestly below, not filled in with sample numbers.

measurableCard.title: What's measurable vs. what isn't
measurableCard.promoCodeDesc: Widget sessions carrying a promo code are tracked back to the owning event — real, see Event & Promo Planner > Evaluation & Attribution.
measurableCard.channelRoasTitle: ROAS/iROAS/CAC per ad channel (TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, Influencer, etc.)
measurableCard.channelRoasDesc: Needs an API integration with each ad platform for spend data, and per-transaction sales data for attributed revenue — neither exists in this project.
measurableCard.mmmTitle: Marketing Mix Modeling & automatic budget allocation
measurableCard.mmmDesc: Needs ≥24 months of weekly per-channel spend data for an adstock/saturation regression — that data doesn't exist at all.
measurableCard.incrementalityDesc: Needs the ability to hold back a campaign in some cities/audiences and compare — no experimentation infrastructure like that exists in this project.

promoChannelCard.title: The only measurable channel right now: promo codes
promoChannelCard.subtitleTemplate: {organik} of {total} total widget sessions are organic (no code) — {attributed} sessions via {eventCount} event promo codes.
promoChannelCard.empty: No event has a promo code set yet.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Hydration, acne and pigmentation scores, plus your colour season (with undertone), face shape and skin type — all from one three-pose scan.
faq.a2: If you're signed in, your scan photo is saved to your account with its result so the Progress Tracker and PDF report can show it. Scans done through a store widget keep only the analysis result for that session, not the photos.
faq.a3: You can start a scan right away. Saving your routine, cart, saved products and progress history requires signing in with Google.
faq.a4: English and Indonesian, for both the app and the advisor's answers.
faq.q5: How do I add the widget to my store?
faq.a5: Paste one '<script>' tag before '</body>' on your website. The widget appears as a floating button; nothing else on your site changes.
